purpose: Private fictional-data testing by the owner before an MVP

network.name: ciq-preview
network.browser_access: outbound HTTPS tunnel to the owner-password gateway

runtime.database: single local PostgreSQL container and persistent Docker volume

build.deployment_images: exact registry SHA-256 digests after acceptance

cost_estimate_usd.basis: 730 hours/month, on-demand US pricing, no credits or free allowances assumed
cost_estimate_usd.additional: image/source storage, builds, bandwidth, logging and applicable taxes

operating_policy.start: manual, only for an approved testing window after builds complete
operating_policy.stop: as soon as testing ends, even before the automatic STOP limit
operating_policy.daily_budget_enforcement: operator uses persistent usage receipts and stops by the remaining Asia/Kolkata allowance; each VM start resets its own STOP timer; not a cloud-enforced daily cap
